hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
cleanup() { local rc=$? local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}"
if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then log "EXIT rc=0 (success). Cleaning AWS env vars." else error "EXIT rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}. Cleaning AWS env vars." fi
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } on_err() { local rc=$? local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}" local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" error "ERR rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}" return $rc } trap on_err ERR trap cleanup EXIT
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
already_in_role() { local role_arn="$1" local role_name role_name="$(printf '%s' "$role_arn" | awk -F'/' '{print $NF}')" local caller_arn caller_arn="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Arn --output text 2>/dev/null || true)" [[ -n "$caller_arn" && "$caller_arn" == *":assumed-role/${role_name}/"* ]] }
assume_role() { local role_arn="${1:-${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}}" local session_name="${2:-${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}}" local duration="${3:-${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-900}}"
if already_in_role "$role_arn"; then log "Already running under role ${role_arn}; skipping AssumeRole" return 0 fi
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (session=${session_name}, duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" }
reset_dir() { rm -rf "$1"; mkdir -p "$1"; }
s3_cp() { # s3_cp <src> <dst> <required:true|false> [extra aws s3 cp args...] local src="$1" dst="$2" required="${3:-true}" shift 3 || true if aws s3 cp "$src" "$dst" --no-progress --only-show-errors "$@"; then return 0 fi if [[ "$required" == "true" ]]; then error "S3 copy failed (required): $src -> $dst" return 1 fi warn "S3 copy failed (optional): $src -> $dst" return 0 }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs + inputs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need tail need java
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}" S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
# ----------------------------- # Workspace (cleanly) # ----------------------------- reset_dir data reset_dir completed reset_dir hierarchies reset_dir processing
rm -rf pic-sure-hpds/ || true
# ----------------------------- # Assume role once for all S3 ops # ----------------------------- assume_role "${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" "s3-test" "900"
# ----------------------------- # Pull managed inputs # ----------------------------- log "Downloading Managed_Inputs.csv" s3_cp "$managed_inputs" "./Managed_Inputs.csv" true
log "Building inputs.csv" csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi" \ Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv
log "inputs.csv preview:" head -n 10 inputs.csv >&2 || true
# ----------------------------- # Pull per-study GlobalVars (sequential, no parallel) # Only for ready studies with has_multi == no # ----------------------------- while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi; do abv_name="${abv_name%\"}"; abv_name="${abv_name#\"}" stdy_id="${stdy_id%\"}"; stdy_id="${stdy_id#\"}" data_ready="${data_ready%\"}"; data_ready="${data_ready#\"}" has_multi="${has_multi%\"}"; has_multi="${has_multi#\"}"
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" != "yes" ]]; then continue fi if [[ "${has_multi,,}" != "no" ]]; then continue fi
local_abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" local_abv_uc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"
log "Fetching ${local_abv_uc}_GlobalVars.csv for ${abv_name} (${stdy_id})" s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${local_abv_lc}/completed/${local_abv_uc}_GlobalVars.csv" \ "data/${local_abv_uc}_GlobalVars.csv" \ false done < <(tail -n +2 inputs.csv | csvformat -U 1)
# ----------------------------- # Pull GLOBAL_allConcepts + merge + upload # ----------------------------- log "Downloading GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" "data/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" true
log "Running MergeGlobalAllConcepts.jar" java -jar jars/MergeGlobalAllConcepts.jar
log "Uploading merged GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" s3_cp "completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" \ true
log "Done"
